name: ADQ (Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company)
via: ADQ received Abu Dhabi state assets (the 2022 SCFEA transfer of Etihad Aviation Group, claim etihad-adq-ownership-2022); its assets and investments were consolidated under L'IMAD Holding by SCFEA resolution of 30 January 2026 (claim etihad-limad-2026)
note: The ADQ mark still ran on the sleeve of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG jersey launched in December 2025, before the January 2026 consolidation into L'IMAD.
